Class EtopoGeoTiffReader

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.EtopoGeoTiffReader
public final class EtopoGeoTiffReader extends Object
Direct high-performance reader for official NOAA ETOPO 2022 Global Relief Model GeoTIFFs (tiled 21600x10800 Float32 rasters with Deflate + Floating-Point horizontal predictor). Decodes exact topography (-11000 m to +8848 m) without external library dependencies.
